author: MonoGame Foundation
name: MonoGame Web Application
description: A MonoGame browser application using the WebGL2 backend.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.

manualInstructions.text: Install the WebAssembly tools workload with 'dotnet workload install wasm-tools', then run 'dotnet restore'.

postActions.description: Add a MonoGame Content Builder project when you need game assets.

manualInstructions.text: Use an existing MonoGame Content Builder project or create one with 'dotnet new mgcb', then import its 'BuildContent.targets' in your web project's .csproj.
